reasoning: The combination of Guillain-Barre syndrome, rapidly progressive weakness, bulbar impairment, ineffective cough, reduced FVC, weak inspiratory pressure, limited speech, and diaphoresis strongly indicates impending ventilatory failure and loss of airway protection.
